headline: Stocks rallied Monday but crypto lagged, a big bitcoin miner sold 13,597 BTC, and Tuesday's inflation report is next.

market.asOf: Read from CoinGecko coin pages at about 00:05 UTC Tue 10 Nov (07:05 Bangkok). The ETH and SOL pages showed the same figures as at 20:00 UTC, so they may be a few hours old. Fear & Greed from Alternative.me at the same time. Use the live prices on this page.
market.fearGreed: 29 (Fear) on the Alternative.me Crypto Fear & Greed Index, up from 28 yesterday.

stories.title: Stocks jump, crypto lags, and miner MARA sells 13,597 BTC
stories.summary: US stocks rose more than 2% on Monday as oil fell on Iran headlines, but bitcoin slipped about 1% and ether fell about 5%, per CoinDesk. After the close, bitcoin miner MARA said it sold 13,597 BTC to fully pay off its bitcoin-backed loans. When crypto falls on a strong day for stocks, the selling is coming from inside crypto.
points: Late Monday afternoon the Nasdaq was up 2.75%, the S&P 500 up 2.35% and Nvidia down 4.3%, while BTC was down 1.1% near $74,800, per CoinDesk.
Bitcoin's Sunday low of about $73,761 was its lowest since August and held just above its 200-day average (about $73,150), per CoinDesk.
About $1.19B of bets were liquidated in 24 hours, $1.04B of them bets on higher prices; ether accounted for $505M, per CoinGlass data via PANews.
MARA used $750M of the sale to fully repay its bitcoin-backed loans and reported Q3 net profit of $634.4M, per The Block; the sale leaves it with 20,415 BTC, per CoinDesk.
Strategy went the other way, buying 1,036 BTC for $81.9M and now holding 850,364 BTC, per The Block.

sources.label: The Block: MARA Q3 and bitcoin sale

stories.title: Inflation report today at 8:30am ET, with a December rate hike seen as likely
stories.summary: October's US consumer price report comes out Tuesday at 8:30am ET (20:30 Bangkok). Markets already expect the Fed to raise rates in December, and a hot number would add to that, which usually weighs on crypto. Because of last year's government shutdown, there will be no official year-over-year inflation rate this time, so watch the monthly figure.
points: Consensus is +0.3% for the month (September +0.6%) and core +0.2% (September +0.3%), per investingLive; the Cleveland Fed nowcast is about 0.2% for both.
CME FedWatch put the odds of a December rate hike at 85% on Monday afternoon, per CoinDesk.
Chicago Fed President Goolsbee said "We've got to come to terms with inflation failure," per CoinDesk.
US spot bitcoin ETFs lost $1.28B last week, the biggest weekly outflow since late June, per SoSoValue data via CoinDesk.

sources.label: CoinDesk: bitcoin bulls can't rely on ETF flows

stories.title: Warren sets out her Senate Banking agenda, with Trump crypto ventures in view
stories.summary: Sen. Elizabeth Warren will chair the Senate Banking Committee in the new year. Her aide listed priorities including prediction markets and accountability, and named Trump-family crypto businesses as targets, per The Block. Expect hearings and document requests rather than friendly new crypto laws.
points: The priorities named are affordability, AI, prediction markets, a potential financial crisis and accountability, per The Block.
Sherrod Brown is expected to lead Senate Agriculture and Maxine Waters House Financial Services, both key committees for crypto, per The Block.
In a 60 Minutes interview, Trump said he knows "nothing" about a UAE-linked investment in World Liberty Financial, per The Block.

sources.label: The Block: Warren's Senate Banking scrutiny

briefs.summary: MSCI publishes the final list of companies affected by its new index rules on Wed 11 Nov, and Strategy could be removed, per The Block.

briefs.summary: Incoming USDC converts 1:1 into dollars in the client's PNC account, using Coinbase's payment tools, per The Block.

briefs.title: Bitmine nears 5% of all ether
briefs.summary: Bitmine bought 9,587 ETH last week and now holds 6.07M ETH, about 4.97% of supply, per The Block.

briefs.title: Nvidia CEO probe drove the risk-off mood
briefs.summary: Nvidia's board opened an independent probe into reports about Jensen Huang's relationship with a business executive; Nvidia says it has no reason to believe secrets were compromised, per CoinDesk.

briefs.title: Binance hackers launder through homemade memecoins
briefs.summary: Elliptic says the North Korean group behind the Binance hack created six memecoins to move about 117K NEAR of stolen funds, per The Block.
